verdict.rationale: Bento documents an official Python SDK with installation, configuration via `init()` (user_id, session_id, tags), `bento.track_ai` for wrapping calls, `bento.flush()` for short-lived processes, an OTel transport mode, and a Google ADK extra. That clearly covers the core of building against an official SDK. The TypeScript path is described as working with no Bento package at all, so only one language SDK is evidenced. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs beyond Python (e.g. a TypeScript/JS package), an SDK API reference or published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration.
